method: Renderer-local Root_M travel retained in sheet. Original source skinned with full captured bone matrices and native IBMs, Anatomy mode removes Root_M using captured Root_M inverse and its rest matrix; keep-root-motion mode retains renderer-local travel in the sheet. Travel bounds always retain renderer-local motion. Orthographic depth raster with fixed all-frame bounds. Mesh-space anatomy front+Z/upY.
scope: Offline native pose study; no material/culling/portrait/whole-controller or live original-art acceptance.
